subject: Ingest pipeline outage — SLO credit request and RCA scope
messages:
From: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@syndexa.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Syndexa Support <ingestops@syndexa.com>
Date: 2028-07-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: High failure rate on ingestion into staging -> production

Avery,

We saw a sharp spike in 500s and 429s from the Redwood ingest endpoint starting around 2028-07-18T08:57:00Z and lasting roughly 25 minutes. This impacted our batch pipeline that pushes daily deltas; roughly 14% of our payloads failed to be accepted which triggered retries and some backpressure in downstream systems. Attached is the initial error log and a screenshot of the dashboard (screenshot-500s.png).

Can you confirm whether this qualifies for SLO credit and what evidence you need? This incident caused a material delay to our nightly reconciliation job. We are a paid customer on the standard committed capacity plan.

Thanks,
Carlos Ruiz
Head of Integrations, Syndexa

attachments: syndexa_ingest_errors_20280718.log, screenshot-500s.png

From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@syndexa.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-18T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: High failure rate on ingestion into staging -> production

Carlos — thanks for the report and the attachments. Sorry for the disruption.

Quick asks so we can scope eligibility:
- Confirm the affected time window in your local logs (UTC preferred). You reported start ~08:57Z; can you provide first failed request timestamp and last failed timestamp?
- Any request ids or client-side spans you can share will help match to our traces.
- Is Syndexa currently seeing ongoing failures or is this fully resolved?

I've looped in Laura (support SLA lead) and Priyom (engineer) to pull SLO math and traces. Marcus will own the postmortem scope for this incident. We will pull our server-side error rates and routing/fallback logs.

I will treat this as a formal SLO inquiry and respond with an eligibility assessment and a proposed RCA schedule by EOD tomorrow.

Regards,
Avery Johnson
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
Cell: +1-415-555-0191

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@syndexa.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: 2028-07-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: High failure rate on ingestion into staging -> production

Hi Carlos/Avery — Laura here. For SLO eligibility we typically need the following artifacts:
- precise affected window (UTC)
- sample request ids or client spans (helps tie to our traces)
- your account id and region (we have regional SLO boundaries)
- clear business impact statement (customers/jobs affected, revenue risk if any)

If the downtime meets our "availability" SLO threshold for committed capacity, we'll calculate a pro-rata credit per the contract and provide the audit math. Please attach the request spans or a short CSV with request ids if possible.

I'll start the internal evidence pull (token, latency, 5xx rates) and will attach the initial SLO calculation to the RCA deliverable.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
SLA & Support Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@syndexa.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Syndexa Support <ingestops@syndexa.com>
Date: 2028-07-18T10:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: High failure rate on ingestion into staging -> production

Avery/Laura — attaching the request span bundle and a CSV of failed request ids. The precise window from our ingest logs: 2028-07-18T08:56:22Z to 2028-07-18T09:21:19Z. Failures were primarily 500s with a few 429s during the retry storm. Impact: our daily delta ingestion job missed the scheduled slot; downstream reconciliation ran late and triggered an incident in our ops team.

I attached: request_span_traces_20280718.json and a CSV called failed_request_ids_20280718.csv (referenced in the attached log bundle). Let me know if you need anything else to confirm credit eligibility.

Carlos

attachments: request_span_traces_20280718.json, failed_request_ids_20280718.csv

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@syndexa.com>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: High failure rate on ingestion into staging -> production

Thanks for the timestamps and traces, Carlos. Initial matching against our ingress traces shows a correlated spike of 5xx responses on the US-west ingest fleet between 2028-07-18T08:54:00Z and 2028-07-18T09:23:00Z. Early signal points to a routing mismatch during a transient autoscaler event where shard getters were briefly returning stale routing tables and produced increased request timeout handling.

Next steps from engineering:
- Produce exact per-shard failure rates and confirm overlap with your failed_request_ids.csv (ETA 2028-07-19 EOD PT).
- Prepare an evidence bundle with token-level ingress counts and per-customer failed requests for SLO math.
- Convene a short RCA working group; Marcus will lead the postmortem.

For now treat this window as eligible for investigation; final SLO credit determination will be provided after we finish the evidence math and confirm no customer-side misconfiguration contributed.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Senior Engineer, Inference Runtime

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@syndexa.com>
Date: 2028-07-20T17:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: High failure rate on ingestion into staging -> production — next steps and RCA timeline

Carlos/Avery/Team — quick status and commitments:

1) Evidence bundle: engineering will deliver the full audit (per-shard failure table, request id overlap, ingress counts) by 2028-07-21 11:00 PT. That bundle will include the SLO calculation and a recommended credit amount if the math qualifies.

2) RCA: we'll run a 3-business-day working group and publish a draft postmortem on 2028-07-25. Public summary will include root cause, backlog mitigation, and a plan for routing table hardening to prevent stale shard lookups.

3) Temporary remediation: we will flip an expanded retry window + soft-hedging routing policy for customers on committed capacity to reduce blast radius during autoscaler transitions. This will be applied to your account by 2028-07-22.

Avery will follow up with the formal credit request and attach the JIRA incident (JIRA-INC-7892) for tracking. If Syndexa needs a faster decision on credits for accounting purposes let me know and we can escalate to finance.

Marcus Lin
Head of Reliability Engineering, Redwood Inference
